slug: 2025-10-11 La RDC prevoit 1,5 milliard $ de budget pour son Plan national du numerique et de l'IA 2026-2030 (Agence Ecofin)

facts.fact: Agence Ecofin reports that the digital economy minister launched the drafting of the Plan national du numérique et de l'IA 2026-2030 (PNN2) on 8 October 2025, with four pillars: infrastructure and connectivity, digital platforms and public services, human capital and inclusion, cybersecurity and digital trust.
facts.system: Plan national du numérique et de l'IA 2026-2030 (PNN2)

facts.fact: Agence Ecofin states the government plans US$1 billion of public investment over five years for the PNN2, plus US$500 million of external support already guaranteed by international partners.
facts.system: Plan national du numérique et de l'IA 2026-2030 (PNN2)

facts.fact: Agence Ecofin reports the ministry estimates the earlier Plan National du Numérique Horizon 2025 (2019) is about 60% complete, citing the CAB5 fibre, an online tax portal, a customs single window, civil-registry digitisation and a digital ID under way; no report against the plan's own targets is cited.

systems.system: Plan national du numérique et de l'IA 2026-2030 (PNN2)
systems.tiers: national; four pillars plus five cross-cutting themes (entrepreneurship, innovation, technological sovereignty, AI, partnerships)

systems.system: National AI strategy (Congolese Academy of AI to be created under it)
